canonical.title: The lightweight per-PR floor for testing Claude Code agent extensions

parent.title: Testing & regression-checking Claude Code agent extensions before you ship them

siblings.title: Testing an authored Claude Code Skill before you ship it to a team
siblings.summary: The two things to test are separable — does the description trigger, and does the body behave — and in 2026 the de-facto harness is Anthropic's skill-creator eval loop plus a with-skill/without-skill baseline; everything else is thin.

siblings.title: Smoke-testing a Claude Code subagent's routing before you ship it
siblings.summary: Promptfoo's claude-agent-sdk provider plus headless stream-json are the only real ways to assert subagent routing in 2026; the description field is the trigger, parent_tool_use_id is the proof.

siblings.title: Regression-testing Claude Code plugins & MCP servers, and catching rug-pulls
siblings.summary: Two test surfaces — functional schema/contract drift and supply-chain rug-pulls — with the 2026 tooling that catches each, and an honest map of where the defenses are still missing.

siblings.title: Testing Claude Code Hooks Before Shipping to a Team
siblings.summary: Hooks are plain scripts with a documented stdin/exit-code/JSON contract — the one Claude Code extension you can test with fully-deterministic CI.

sources.title: Claude Code headless mode (docs)
sources.claim: claude -p headless flags: --bare, --output-format json/stream-json, --json-schema, --max-turns; system/init reports plugins and plugin_errors; docs say use them to fail CI when a plugin did not load.

sources.title: Claude Code plugins reference (docs)
sources.claim: claude plugin validate reports unknown fields as warnings; --strict promotes them to errors for CI; $schema points at json.schemastore.org/claude-code-plugin-manifest.json.

sources.title: Claude Code skills reference (docs)
sources.claim: SKILL.md frontmatter fields and the 1,536-character truncation cap on description+when_to_use; skills follow the agentskills.io open standard.

sources.title: anthropics/claude-code #14490 — --strict-mcp-config
sources.claim: --strict-mcp-config loads only the specified MCP config and ignores other sources but has a known bug where it does not override disabledMcpServers.

sources.title: TheStack-ai/pulser
sources.claim: pulser is a zero-dependency SKILL.md linter, ~200ms for 40+ skills, available as npx pulser eval and a GitHub Action.

sources.title: Testing Claude Code Skills in CI: pulser eval GitHub Action
sources.claim: pulser eval runs 5 structural checks; GitHub Action gated on .claude/** adds ~15s; exit codes 0/1/2.

sources.title: agent-ecosystem/skill-validator
sources.claim: skill-validator checks spec compliance, token counts, link resolution, file hygiene, unclosed code fences; supports GitHub Actions annotations and --strict; optional LLM-judge score evaluate mode.

sources.title: hesreallyhim/claude-code-json-schema (archived)
sources.claim: Unofficial JSON schemas for plugin.json/marketplace.json, now archived because official schemas shipped on SchemaStore.

sources.title: swarmclawai/agent-skills-lint
sources.claim: Cross-agent skill validator covering Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others; validates name+description core schema plus per-flavor rules.

sources.title: anthropics/claude-code-action usage docs
sources.claim: anthropics/claude-code-action is the official GitHub Action built on the Agent SDK for PR/issue automation and review.

sources.title: claude doctor diagnostics (blog)
sources.claim: claude doctor checks API connectivity, MCP server health, hook syntax validity, and shell integration before a session.

sources.title: Claude Code GitHub Action flaw (The Hacker News)
sources.claim: A June 2026 disclosure showed a Claude Code GitHub Action flaw where one malicious issue could hijack repositories.

sources.title: I Audited 214 Claude Code Skills — 73% Were Silently Broken
sources.claim: A community audit of 214 published skills claimed 73% had silent structural defects.

sources.title: SkillCheck
sources.claim: SkillCheck validates Agent Skills against the Anthropic open standard for free; Pro adds anti-slop, WCAG and security scanning.

sources.title: jeremylongshore/claude-code-plugins-plus-skills
sources.claim: Large community marketplace that runs claude plugin validate over marketplace.json and every plugin.json in CI so invalid manifests cannot merge.

sources.title: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
sources.claim: Anthropic's official plugin marketplace, the reference marketplace.json to diff a schema against.

sources.title: glebis/claude-skills
sources.claim: A clean small collection of Claude Code skills usable as a corpus to test linting tooling.
